name: yaozhuo
description: 謠诼 · 内置微信资料读取、人物线索与资料综述
author: Yaozhuo contributors

scripts.test:caseboard: node scripts/test-caseboard.cjs && node scripts/test-analysis-runtime.cjs && node --test electron/caseboard/*.test.cjs native/key-reader/windows/key-reader.test.cjs
scripts.build:caseboard: npm run build:key-reader && npm run build:characters && npm run typecheck:caseboard && vite build --config vite.caseboard.config.ts
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:caseboard && electron-builder --config electron-builder.caseboard.cjs --win --x64 --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:caseboard && electron-builder --config electron-builder.caseboard.cjs --mac --universal --publish never
